New issue opened on their github! You can track the changes and comments here: https://github.com/voat/voat/issues/654

Update: apparently this issue is browser specific. Voat is using a responsive design and doesn't have seperate mobile and desktop versions. This much we already knew, someone else commented on this post saying so. What's going on is that the other browsers' 'Request Desktop Site' modes are only spoofing a desktop User Agent string, but they're not spoofing a desktop resolution. Firefox for android seems to be the only browser that is currently doing this properly. A bug report will have to be sent into Apple so that they can correct this behavior in Safari. I took the liberty of sending in a report myself. You can do the same if you like using the following link: https://www.apple.com/feedback/safari.html
